bench_e2e.title: End-to-end SQL bioseq.load + mmsearch vs minimap2 (2/4 Gbp dna4/dna5)
bench_e2e.description: Focused production Format-5 all-SIMD cold just_index versus minimap2 map-only. The exact two-row acceptance contract permits an all-row cases filter without weakening the default six-row signoff contract.
